title: Columnar
description: Datapack for consistency within various Stoneset recipes as well as expanded Blast Furnace smelting!
body:
# Choco's Columnar!

No more Blackstone bias or Deepslate hate! Substitute Blackstone/Deepslate with Cobblestone interchangeably for all Stone Workbench crafting recipes! This datapack corrects various Stonecutting recipes as well as expands Blast Furnace's smelting options!

### Other Resources
Visit [Chocos/mygazthehealer](https://www.planetminecraft.com/member/mygazthehealer/) in PlanetMinecraft for reporting issues or discussions/recommendation/suggestions for the pack. Refer the gallery for a complete list of recipes changed/added.

### NOTE
If you disagree with a certain recipe but still want to use this datapack, you may delete the .json file corresponding to that recipe. Feel free to edit this recipepack for your personal preference!
